title: Categorical Equivalences of Finite W-Superalgebras and Clifford Twists
summary: Associated with an even nilpotent element $e$ in a basic classical Lie superalgebra $\mathfrak{g}$, we study, in full generality, two constructions of finite $W$-superalgebras, defined via Whittaker models and isotropic subspaces, respectively. We prove that both formulations are independent of the various choices made in their constructions, thereby yielding, for a fixed good grading for $e$, at most two isomorphism classes of $W$-superalgebras.
